title: Warm Lo-Fi Music Bed
tests: Checks whether the delivered music matches the stated mood, genre and duration without unnecessary clarification.

faults.what: The delivered audio is 15 seconds long, exceeding the requested 10 seconds by 5 seconds.

judge.summary: An audio file was delivered with no reported speech, but it runs 15 seconds instead of the requested 10, and its musical style and mood cannot be verified from the supplied transcription.

must_haves.item: One playable music audio file is delivered.
must_haves.why: One WAV file, 01-generate_music.wav, is supplied with reported duration and peak level.

must_haves.item: The audio lasts 10 seconds, within 0.1 second.
The music has a recognizable laid-back hip-hop beat and mellow lo-fi texture.
must_haves.why: The transcription does not establish the beat or texture, and the audio cannot be heard.

must_haves.item: The overall mood is warm and relaxed rather than tense or high-energy.
must_haves.why: The supplied transcription does not describe the mood.

must_haves.item: No singing or spoken words are audible.
must_haves.why: The supplied sound description reports no clear speech and explicitly states that stray transcription fragments are not speech; no vocals are reported.
